messages:
leo.partnerships: HelixCloud just sent the co-branded solution brief + marketplace artboard. Quick QA please: logo lockup, neutral-bg variant, one-line customer quote clearance. Need approvals by Fri noon PT.

maya.design: Glancing now. Their master SVG includes nested masks that break when resized. I can flatten and produce a 2-color flat variant for small sizes. Will upload to Figma: https://figma.com/file/helix/helix-redwood-lockups.

ben.marketing: The hero copy is wordy. Current: 'Redwood + HelixCloud: next-gen inference for real-time apps at enterprise scale.' Propose two options: short benefit-forward and conservative. Also need a 20-word marketplace summary for SEO. I'll post drafts.

sai.prod: Product note: they claim "50% lower inference cost" but that's from a mixed workload with caching enabled. Suggest: 'up to 50% cost reduction on cache-friendly workloads' + an inline footnote with test config. We should attach the abbreviated test harness: `HW: 8xH100, model=redwood-large, batch=16, cache=enabled`.

emma.legal: Legal flags: 1) must get signed co-brand license from Helix legal; 2) need explicit written consent for the customer quote; 3) marketplace requires the hedging line: 'Performance results based on specific tests; results may vary.' I'll send the standard addendum template.

assets-bot: Reminder: marketplace asset checklist incomplete: missing signed license, flattened SVG, and accessibility contrast report. See https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist.

leo.partnerships: Plan: maya to export flat/mono lockups, ben to post two headline variants + 20-word summary, sai to prepare the sanitized test caption, emma to request signatures. Target upload Mon if all approvals in by Fri noon.

maya.design: Uploaded flattened and mono exports to Figma and attached export zip to thread.

ben.marketing: Posted two headline options in thread: A) 'Redwood + HelixCloud 12 inference that saves.' B) 'Reduce inference cost for latency-sensitive apps.' Also posted a 20-word summary.

sai.prod: Added test caption and short reproducibility note to the doc.

emma.legal: Sent addendum to Helix legal; awaiting sign. Will update when received.

leo.partnerships: Thanks everyone. If Helix signs and legal greenlights copy, we'll queue for marketplace submission next week. /remind me to follow up Fri 11am. :calendar:
